overview: This brief segment captures the tail end of a Marathon County Infrastructure Committee meeting, following a closed session. The committee returned from closed session and passed a motion requiring Bug Tussle — a broadband internet provider — to submit a detailed project scope change document outlining mileage and tower modifications, a completion schedule, and a plan to increase subscriber take rate by the November Infrastructure Committee meeting before the matter can advance to the full County Board of Supervisors. The meeting then adjourned.
presiding: Lance [last name inaudible] (appears to serve as staff facilitator or chair; Kurt Gibbs not confirmed as presiding in this segment)

agenda.item: Motion regarding Bug Tussle project scope change requirements

discussions.item: Bug Tussle Broadband Project — Scope Change Requirements
discussions.body: Following closed session, a committee member made a motion requiring Bug Tussle to provide a detailed project scope change explaining specific mileage changes, tower changes, a completion schedule for each proposed modification, and a plan to increase subscriber take rate — all due by the November Infrastructure Committee meeting as a condition of advancing the matter to the County Board of Supervisors. Supervisor Watson seconded the motion. The motion carried on a voice vote with all members present voting aye. A staff member identified as Lance indicated he would send the formal request to the Bug Tussle team, addressing someone named George on the Bug Tussle side.
Supervisor Watson moved to adjourn and the motion was seconded. The motion carried unanimously on a voice vote.
